content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Karwar Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS Karwar Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ECHS Karwar Medical Officer post is 10th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree and have a minimum of 3 years of experience after completing their internship. Additional qualifications in medicine or surgery are preferable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Officer position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 95,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Medical Officer post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the ECHS Karwar located?
faq.answer: ECHS Karwar is located in Karwar, Karnataka, with the pincode 581308.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Medical Officer post.

faq.question: Q10. Who can I contact if I have further queries?
faq.answer: For any further queries, it is advisable to refer to the official notification or contact the ECHS Karwar office directly through the details provided on their official website.
